auth_account.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_account (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	contact_email VARCHAR(320), 
	contact_email_key VARCHAR(320), 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	admission_epoch VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_auth_account_status CHECK (status IN ('admitted','suspended','pending')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_auth_account_role CHECK (role IN ('member','admin')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_auth_account_version CHECK (auth_version > 0)
)

indexes.name: ix_auth_account_contact_email_key
indexes.create_sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_auth_account_contact_email_key ON auth_account (contact_email_key)

auth_audit_event.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_audit_event (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	correlation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

auth_throttle.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_throttle (
	key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key_hash)
)

auth_external_identity.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_external_identity (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_auth_external_subject UNIQUE (issuer, subject), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES auth_account (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

auth_invitation.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_invitation (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	recipient_email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	recipient_email_key VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	inviter_id VARCHAR(36), 
	restore_epoch VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inviter_id) REFERENCES auth_account (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES auth_account (id)
)

auth_session.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_session (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	public_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	method VARCHAR(24), 
	csrf_secret VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	restore_epoch VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	account_auth_version INTEGER, 
	invitation_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	idle_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	absolute_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	authenticated_at DATETIME, 
	provider_auth_time DATETIME, 
	mfa_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	UNIQUE (public_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES auth_account (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

auth_transaction.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_transaction (
	state_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	session_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (state_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_hash) REFERENCES auth_session (token_hash) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
